LESSON: RELATIONSHIP

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Relationship

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Relationship. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do you help your b) Identify ways through which obligations towards their neighbour?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Appreciate the love and care for  Learners act short skits neighbours as an act of ibadah. demonstrating good relations with neighbours.  Learners guided to role play on how to love and care for their neighbours
2. Demonstrate love and care for crutches people with special needs.  Learners dramatise how to take care of people with special needs

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: RELATIONSHIP
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Relationship helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: RELATIONSHIP

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Relationship” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: Appreciate the love and care for  Learners act short skits neighbours as an act of ibadah. demonstrating good relations with neighbours.  Learners guided to role play on how to love and care for their neighbours)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Relationship to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: Appreciate the love and care for  Learners act short skits neighbours as an act of ibadah. demonstrating good relations with neighbours.  Learners guided to role play on how to love and care for their neighbours.
3. Practise this skill: Demonstrate love and care for crutches people with special needs.  Learners dramatise how to take care of people with special needs.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Relationship from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Relationship: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study Relationship?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

1. Know what Relationship means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: Appreciate the love and care for  Learners act short skits neighbours as an act of ibadah. demonstrating good relations with neighbours.  Learners guided to role play on how to love and care for their neighbours.
